payload.title: Spoofable BATS env enables arbitrary cost-report script execution
payload.description: The new LOA_BUDGET_COST_REPORT_SCRIPT seam executes an environment-provided path whenever BATS_TEST_FILENAME or BATS_VERSION is set. Those variables are not trustworthy outside the test runner; a caller that can influence the enforcer environment can set BATS_VERSION=1 and LOA_BUDGET_COST_REPORT_SCRIPT=/path/to/payload to make budget_verdict execute arbitrary shell code. This turns a test-only seam into a runtime command execution path.
payload.recommendation: Do not execute LOA_BUDGET_COST_REPORT_SCRIPT based only on spoofable environment markers. Restrict the script seam to an explicit internal test mode that cannot be set in production, remove the executable-script seam entirely, or require the seam path to live under a controlled test directory and be enabled only by the test harness.
